verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. Necessity follows from the injective map sending each vertex of X to its matched endpoint. For sufficiency, the induction on |X| is valid: a proper tight subset yields two smaller induced bipartite graphs satisfying the neighborhood condition and matchings with disjoint vertex sets, while in the absence of a proper tight subset, deleting a chosen adjacent pair preserves the neighborhood condition on the remaining graph. The base case and all edge cases are covered. The statement is self-contained, no prohibited justification occurs, and there are no external or fact-graph references requiring validation.
